title: What Is Seattle Reading?
description: Explore millions of Seattle Public Library checkouts. Search any author or title, and browse top 10 rankings.
keywords: seattle public library, books, checkouts, data, authors, titles, genres
dek: The Seattle Public Library logs millions of book checkouts a year. Search an author or title to see a book's popularity over time. Explore the Top 10 authors and works for different genres and years.
note: Based on a sample of SPL open checkout data, 2018–2022.
